_readme: Edit this file to update your menu — no need to touch index.html. Each item needs: id (never change once live — it's used by the cart), cat (category, used for filtering), kind (only for freshItems: 'red' or 'white'), name, desc, price (numbers only, no 'KSh'), unit (e.g. 'kg', 'plate', 'wrap'), and img (filename of a photo in the images/ folder, or leave as an empty string "" to show a placeholder instead). Optional: badges (array of short strings shown as pills, e.g. ["Grass-Fed", "Free-Range"] — only add claims that are actually true, leave as [] to use the generic default) and origin (a short text note on where it's sourced from, e.g. "Sourced from Kajiado" — leave as "" to omit). To add a new item, copy an existing block and give it a new unique id. To remove an item, delete its block.

freshItems.name: Beef Rump
freshItems.desc: Lean, tender cut with good beef flavour. Great for nyama choma, grilled steaks or a quick mchuzi. Tell us the thickness you want.

freshItems.name: Beef Ribeye
freshItems.desc: Well-marbled steak that stays rich and juicy. Sear on a hot pan or charcoal, then rest it a few minutes before slicing.

freshItems.name: Beef Mince
freshItems.desc: Freshly minced beef for stews, burgers, samosas and meatballs. Cooks quickly and takes up spices well.

freshItems.name: Pork Chops
freshItems.desc: Bone-in chops, trimmed and ready to marinate. Lovely fried, grilled or baked with garlic and herbs.

freshItems.name: Pork Ribs
freshItems.desc: Meaty rack for slow grilling or baking. Marinate overnight, then cook low and slow until the meat comes off the bone.

freshItems.name: Broiler Chicken (Whole)
freshItems.desc: Whole broiler, cleaned and ready to cook. The everyday choice for roasting, frying or a family kuku mchuzi.

freshItems.name: Chicken Breast
freshItems.desc: Skinless, boneless fillets. Lean and quick to cook — good for grilling, stir-fry or slicing into sandwiches.

freshItems.name: Tilapia (Whole)
freshItems.desc: Fresh whole tilapia, scaled and gutted on request. Fry it crisp or grill with lemon, and serve with ugali and kachumbari.

freshItems.name: Nile Perch Fillet
freshItems.desc: Boneless white fillet with a mild taste. Pan-fry, grill or simmer in coconut sauce — no bones to worry about.

freshItems.name: Sirloin Steak
freshItems.desc: Tender steak with a thin strip of fat for flavour. Best seared quickly on a hot grill or pan, then rested.

freshItems.name: T-Bone Steak
freshItems.desc: Two steaks in one — soft fillet and firmer sirloin, divided by the T-shaped bone. Cook it thick over charcoal for a proper weekend braai.

freshItems.name: Topside Steak
freshItems.desc: Lean, good-value cut. Slice thin for stir-fry, or roast and slow-cook until soft.

freshItems.name: Beef Short Ribs
freshItems.desc: Meaty beef ribs cut across the bone. Braise slowly in a mchuzi, or grill until sticky and tender.

freshItems.name: Oxtail
freshItems.desc: Rich and full of flavour. Simmer slowly for a few hours until the meat falls off the bone — best with rice or chapati.

freshItems.name: Beef Liver
freshItems.desc: Fresh liver, trimmed and ready. Slice and fry with onions for a quick meal; don't overcook or it turns hard.

freshItems.name: Beef Soup Bones
freshItems.desc: Beef bones with marrow for a rich supu. Simmer for a few hours with ginger, garlic and onions.

freshItems.name: Chicken Thighs
freshItems.desc: Juicy bone-in thighs, skin on. They stay moist when grilled, fried or simmered, so they are hard to overcook.

freshItems.name: Chicken Drumsticks
freshItems.desc: Whole drumsticks, farm fresh. A family favourite — roast, fry or grill, and the kids will ask for more.

freshItems.name: Chicken Wings
freshItems.desc: Meaty wings for grilling or deep-frying. Marinate with garlic, lemon and a little pilipili for the best flavour.

freshItems.name: Chicken Liver
freshItems.desc: Fresh liver, cleaned and ready. Soft and quick to cook — fry with onions and dhania.

freshItems.name: Gizzard
freshItems.desc: Cleaned chicken gizzard with a firm bite. Boil until tender, then fry or add to a stew.

freshItems.name: Prawns
freshItems.desc: Fresh prawns, cleaned and deveined. They cook in minutes — garlic, butter and lemon is all they need.

freshItems.name: Salmon Fillet
freshItems.desc: Boneless imported salmon fillet, rich and soft. Pan-sear skin side down or bake with lemon and herbs.

freshItems.name: Omena (Dagaa)
freshItems.desc: Sun-dried omena, a Kenyan favourite. Wash well and fry with onions and tomatoes; serve with ugali and sukuma wiki.

freshItems.name: Goat Ribs
freshItems.desc: Goat ribs, bone-in and cut for nyama choma. Roast slowly over charcoal and serve with kachumbari.

freshItems.name: Goat Meat (Mbuzi)
freshItems.desc: Cubed mbuzi, ready for the pot or the grill. Boil until tender, then fry or stew.

freshItems.name: Mutton/Lamb Chops
freshItems.desc: Tender chops cut to order. Grill or pan-fry with salt, garlic and a little rosemary.

freshItems.name: Kienyeji Chicken (Whole)
freshItems.desc: Free-range kienyeji chicken, slow-grown and firmer. It takes longer to cook, but gives the deep flavour of a traditional mchuzi.

freshItems.name: Smoked Fish (Tilapia)
freshItems.desc: Tilapia smoked over firewood the traditional way. Flake it into stew, ugali or managu, or enjoy it as it is.

freshItems.name: Omena (Fresh/Wet)
freshItems.desc: Fresh, undried omena. Fry the same day with onions, or add straight to the pot — soft and quick to cook.

freshItems.name: Beef Sausages
freshItems.desc: Juicy beef sausages for breakfast, a braai or a quick stew. Grill, pan-fry or boil.

freshItems.name: Pork Sausages
freshItems.desc: Seasoned pork sausages with a good fat balance. Great on the grill or in the frying pan.

freshItems.name: Smokies (Pack of 10)
freshItems.desc: Small smoked sausages — the Kenyan street-food favourite. Make smokie pasua, or pack them in a lunchbox.

freshItems.name: Beef Stew Pack
freshItems.desc: 1kg diced beef with tomatoes, onions and fresh dhania. Everything for a family mchuzi in one add-to-cart.

freshItems.name: Goat Stew Pack (Mbuzi)
freshItems.desc: 1kg mbuzi cut for the pot, with tomatoes, onions and dhania. Simmer slowly for a rich stew.

freshItems.name: Chicken Stew Pack
freshItems.desc: A whole broiler cut up for stewing, with tomatoes, onions and dhania. Dinner sorted.

freshItems.name: Tilapia Fry Basket
freshItems.desc: 1kg whole tilapia, scaled and gutted, with lemons, tomatoes, onions and dhania. Fry it and make kachumbari to match.

freshItems.name: Fish Lover's Basket
freshItems.desc: 1kg whole tilapia plus ½kg fresh omena and lemons. Two favourites in one basket.

freshItems.name: Bone Broth Bundle
freshItems.desc: 1kg beef soup bones with fresh ginger and garlic. Simmer for hours for a warming supu on a cold evening.

readyItems.name: Nyama Choma (Beef)
readyItems.desc: Charcoal-grilled beef, chopped and served hot. Add kachumbari and ugali for the full nyama choma plate.

readyItems.name: Grilled Chicken
readyItems.desc: Half or whole chicken, marinated and grilled over charcoal to order. Smoky, juicy and served hot.

readyItems.name: Fried Chicken
readyItems.desc: Crispy fried chicken pieces, made fresh to order. Best with chips and kachumbari.

readyItems.name: Fried Fish
readyItems.desc: Whole or filleted tilapia, deep-fried until crisp. Served with ugali, kachumbari and lemon.

readyItems.name: Beef Shawarma
readyItems.desc: Tender beef, fresh salad and house sauce in a warm wrap. A filling meal you can eat on the go.

readyItems.name: Chicken Shawarma
readyItems.desc: Tender chicken, fresh salad and house sauce in a warm wrap. A filling meal you can eat on the go.

readyItems.name: Fried Omena (Crispy Dagaa)
readyItems.desc: Crispy fried omena — salty, crunchy and hot. A classic with ugali, or a snack with a cold drink.

readyItems.name: Grilled Kienyeji Chicken
readyItems.desc: Half or whole kienyeji chicken, marinated and charcoal-grilled. Firmer meat and richer flavour than broiler.

readyItems.name: Smokie Pasua
readyItems.desc: A grilled smokie split open and topped with fresh kachumbari. The classic Kenyan street bite.

readyItems.name: Grilled Beef Sausage
readyItems.desc: Beef sausage charcoal-grilled to order and served with kachumbari.

groceryItems.name: Tomatoes
groceryItems.desc: Fresh, ripe tomatoes for kachumbari and the base of any mchuzi.

groceryItems.name: Onions
groceryItems.desc: Red onions — the starting point of almost every Kenyan stew and fry.

groceryItems.name: Dhania (Coriander)
groceryItems.desc: Fresh dhania, sold by the bunch. Add near the end of cooking for aroma and colour.

groceryItems.name: Pilipili (Chili)
groceryItems.desc: Fresh pilipili, green or red. Use sparingly in kachumbari, marinades and sauces.

groceryItems.name: Lemon
groceryItems.desc: Fresh lemons. Squeeze over grilled fish or chicken, or into a marinade.

groceryItems.name: Potatoes
groceryItems.desc: Fresh potatoes for chips, mashed potato or to give a stew more body.

groceryItems.name: Kachumbari Mix
groceryItems.desc: Pre-chopped tomato, onion and dhania, ready to serve with nyama choma, chips or ugali.

groceryItems.name: Garlic
groceryItems.desc: Fresh garlic bulbs for marinades, stews and soups.

groceryItems.name: Ginger
groceryItems.desc: Fresh ginger root. Good in tea, marinades and broths.

groceryItems.name: Royco / Meat Masala
groceryItems.desc: All-purpose seasoning for stews, grills and fried meat. A little goes a long way.

groceryItems.name: Cooking Oil
groceryItems.desc: Vegetable cooking oil, 1 litre. For frying, sautéing and deep-frying.

groceryItems.name: Eggs (Tray of 30)
groceryItems.desc: Standard eggs, tray of 30. For breakfast, baking or mayai pasua.

groceryItems.name: Kienyeji Eggs (Tray of 30)
groceryItems.desc: Free-range kienyeji eggs, tray of 30. Smaller, with richer yolks — the ones many households ask for by name.
